purpose: Teach: 間際/色合い/メシ/大いなる/不可解/非常識/あきらか/捜し

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お母さんが出かける間際にお声かけてね
lines.en: Sho, give Mom a call before she heads out, okay?
lines.style: Warm, gentle reminder. Soft opening. Matter-of-fact but affectionate. The tone of someone looking after something small and important.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絵の色合い、お父さんと話したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I talked to Dad about the colors in my painting!
lines.style: Bright, eager rush of words. Pride mixed with the need to share immediately. Quick pace, genuine excitement breaking through his usual quiet.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが、メシ屋でご馳走してくれるって
lines.en: That's lovely. Grandpa's going to treat you to dinner at the restaurant, you know.
lines.style: Warm, knowing tone. Slight pause before the announcement, like she's been holding this good news. Gentle smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、大いなる夢を持ってるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I have a really big dream.
lines.style: Serious little voice. Quiet certainty. Holding the weight of something he's been thinking about. Slight pause after, waiting for her to listen.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんの行動、ちょっと不可解よ
lines.en: Your grandmother's been acting rather strangely, hasn't she?
lines.style: Bemused, almost to herself. Light, wry amusement at something only she's noticed. Warm underneath—not mocking, observing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、非常識なお友達と遊ばないよ
lines.en: I don't play with kids who don't have good manners, Mei-sis.
lines.style: Serious, matter-of-fact statement. Quiet conviction. No performance, just a six-year-old being clear about what he knows is right.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、あきらかに、お父さんは疲れていらっしゃるわね
lines.style: Soft, noticing tone. Gentle concern underneath. She's been watching him. Not worried, just aware—the way she is with people she cares about.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんの家でなくしたおもちゃ、捜してね
lines.en: Will you help me find my toy that I lost at Grandpa's house, Mei-sis?
lines.style: Small, hopeful voice. Trusting her completely. A gentle request, not demanding. Ends on her name like she's his anchor.
